english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for material wrapped around or covering a wound.

examples.english: I cut my hand, so I’ll put on a bandage before going back to work.
examples.traditional: 我隻手割親，包好條繃帶先至返工。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 sau2 got3 can1 baau1 hou2 tiu4 bang1 daai3 sin1 zi3 faan1 gung1
